title: Fourier support of the four-bit equality polynomial
statement: On the sign cube of dimension four, define $P(x)=-3+\sum_{0\le i<j<4}x_i x_j$. Its Fourier support, meaning the subsets with nonzero Fourier coefficient, consists exactly of the empty set and the six two-element subsets of $\{0,1,2,3\}$.
